s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic eye symptoms with progressive vision loss and conjunctival abnormalities
key_facts: Initial visual acuity was 20/20 OD and 20/30 OS
Vision deteriorated to 20/30 OD and counting fingers OS over time
Slit lamp examination revealed subconjunctival fibrosis
Slit lamp examination revealed symblepharon formation
Slit lamp examination revealed corneal neovascularizations
Slit lamp examination revealed conjunctival hyperemia
Conjunctival biopsy and immunofluorescent histology revealed an unspecific result
Reduction in conjunctival hyperemia and corneal vascularizations after therapy

raw.rationale: The presence of subconjunctival fibrosis, symblepharon formation, and corneal neovascularizations are characteristic features of Ocular Cicatricial Pemphigoid, which is a chronic autoimmune disease that leads to scarring and vision loss.

rejected.label: Mucous Membrane Pemphigoid
rejected.why: While it shares some similar symptoms, Mucous Membrane Pemphigoid typically involves more mucous membranes beyond the eyes and doesn't as specifically match the combination of eye symptoms described.

rejected.label: Stevens-Johnson Syndrome
rejected.why: This condition is more acute and involves widespread skin and mucous membrane lesions, which are not mentioned in the vignette.

rejected.label: Chronic Graft-Versus-Host Disease
rejected.why: This condition occurs in the context of bone marrow or stem cell transplantation, which is not mentioned in the patient's history.

rejected.label: Sjögren's Syndrome
rejected.why: Primarily involves dry eyes and dry mouth, with systemic manifestations, which are not the primary focus of the symptoms described.

rejected.label: Vernal Keratoconjunctivitis
rejected.why: Typically presents with intense itching, photophobia, and stringy discharge, which are not highlighted in the vignette.

rejected.label: Atopic Keratoconjunctivitis
rejected.why: Associated with atopic diseases like eczema and asthma, and symptoms include severe itching and stringy discharge, not primarily mentioned here.

rejected.label: Linear IgA Disease
rejected.why: Involves a specific autoimmune response with distinct immunofluorescence findings, which were not identified in the biopsy results provided.

rejected.label: Mucous Membrane Pemphigoid
rejected.why: Does not as closely match the specific eye findings and progression as Ocular Cicatricial Pemphigoid does.
